moment.title: CASCADE
lines: Lighting three or more nodes in one settle banks RAM into your next turn instead of spending it now.
Six or more shatters every enemy lock on this board. Ten or more also destroys one armed enemy trap. Hold the chain, then flip it.

claims.resolves: cascadeRam returns 0 when lit < 3, so three built nodes in one settle is the first count that pays banked RAM.
surgeTierOf returns surge at lit >= 6; settleBoard uses that tier to shatter every enemy lock on the board.
surgeTierOf returns break at lit >= 10; settleBoard uses that tier to also destroy one armed enemy trap.
